title: Even Easier Covalent
tagline: Frontend for no-code use of the covalent API. Put in a couple parameters and get a JSON response.
description: The project allows users to configure and use the Covalent API without knowing how to code. Choose a chainId, an endpoint category and an endpoint, input in the parameters that you are interested in and boom, it'll display the json response directly on the webpage for you. All non-base endpoints supported.
how_its_made: Entire project is built in React. Vite used to in development. Used github. Used some opensource react components. Uses the Covalent API. Not much more to add. Had to learn React to build this as I wanted to hack on Covalent which was a challenge in a short period of time. Otherwise pretty simple.
